evidence.note: 3 time.time reads routed via Clock; resultcache tests 35 passed; test_resultcache_reads_the_wall_clock_only_through_the_clock_port

chunk_findings.detail: The new test only AST-scans for `time.time` / `time.monotonic` when the base name is literally `time`; it never imports `resultcache` or drives `store`/`prune` with a fake Clock. The test can therefore stay green while the module still bypasses the Clock port: for example, changing the source to `from time import time as wall` and calling `wall()` (or `import time as t; t.time()`) leaves `direct == []` even though the wall clock is read directly. It also does not verify that `CLOCK.wall()` is actually available or used correctly, so it does not keep the promise in its name that the module reads the wall clock only through the Clock port.
